Another big week in the sky and beyond at NASA 🚀   🔭 Roman gets a major mission-life boost 🏈 NASA takes to the skies over Pittsburgh 🌕 Artemis III booster stacking nears completion   Here’s what’s new in your NASA Minute!
50 years ago today, we introduced Enterprise. 🚀 NASA’s first Space Shuttle orbiter never flew to space, but the tests it performed helped make the shuttle missions that followed possible.
Turns out you can dance in space! 🪩🕺💫🛰️ Microgravity just unlocked some new moves.
@NFL fans… you might want want to start looking up 👀 We’ve got more headed your way. 🇺🇸
Another week of building the future at NASA. 🚀   🎓 U.S. Space Academy work gets underway 🇺🇸 NASA hits the road across America 📡 Guam Remote Station is back online   Here’s your NASA Minute!

We’re going back to the Moon. This time, to stay. 🌙 Since announcing plans for a Moon Base in March, NASA has been moving quickly to turn that vision into reality. No aim too high. No journey too far.

As Summer winds down, the momentum is picking up 🚀 🔭 Roman Space Telescope opens a new era of discovery 🇺🇸 @President Donald J Trump congratulates NASA on successful launch 🌕 Artemis III SLS engines installed 🛰️ Another successful ISS spacewalk Here’s your NASA Minute!

Roman’s first images will be so large and detailed, you’d need a 4K TV the size of 45 city blocks to display just one. 🤯 The telescope is traveling 1 million miles from Earth, with its first images expected in early 2027. 🔭
When the President calls in the middle of your post-launch press conference, you put him on speaker. 🇺🇸🚀 “Keep it up, we’re back!”
We just launched a new telescope into space. 🚀 The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is officially on its way. Time to unlock the secrets of the universe. 🔭

Here’s a final set of presses for my chest training. When hitting peak fatigue, I’ll do two rest pauses and as many half reps as I can at the end. CONTROL THE WEIGHT - ESPECIALLY at the end when you’re so f*cking fatigued and all you got left is your grit and guts 🤪 - that’s the time to really CONTROL YOUR FORM. At this point it’s all mental flow state through the pain - and that’s where the magic happens. On the other side of is your pain, is your greatness. Then we’ll cry together after the set 😭😂 🤜🏾🤛🏼 As I said in my other post, I took a full year to drop approximately 50lbs (to play my character in Benny Safdie’s Lizard Music”) going from 285lbs which was my weight for filming “The Smashing Machine” to my current weight of 234lbs. Wanted to take my time and cut the weight in a smart, wise way that didn’t involve anything extreme or any kind of crash cutting. Doing it this way created a great opportunity for me to become super acutely attuned to my body - mentally/spiritually and of course physically. It’s also given me a completely new perspective on the “mind muscle connection” that we as athletes are always chasing. Full sovereignty over my trials, errors and progress. That’s the way we want it. I’ll post more training/training philosophy vids as I’m able to. And can’t wait to expand this overall conversation with all you guys about training, health, nutrition, wellness, peak performance etc - when we launch @ProjectRock 10.0 🗡️ 🛡️

This is insane 🤯 🎶 📈 I wrote and performed “Your Dad” as my love letter to my three daughters - Simone, Jazzy & Tia. A record exec called me and I said “ahh you’re calling to tell me congrats on my song being #3. He said no, I’m calling to say congrats on your song becoming a “global top 10 hit”… that’s a better way to phrase it” Yup much better way to say it 🤣😎🎶 Every man wants a son, but every man NEEDS a daughter. I’m blessed beyond words to be my daughter’s dad and as I say in the song “a deeper love that I never knew, you took my heart and you pulled me through…” Amazing to see how this song has touched so many of you - because you live it as well. Shout to my co-writer and brother @Iam Tongi, for helping us bring our fatherly emotions together. Love you uso. #YourDad #VoicesAcrossTheOcean

One of them is how deeply soul stirring, and heart aching this disease is as it grips so many of us. I’ve realized that it’s our most profound test of grace, to watch our loved one, slip away. My journey with writer/director Greg Kwedar has already been life changing. A deepening bond through the experience of this disease, that will live far beyond this film. Thank you brother. And thank you to Ben Affleck and Matt Damon and @Artists Equity for being there for Greg and I. Embracing our project, and embracing this subject with unconditional love and humanity. Shoulder to shoulder. May the sunspots guide us. We look forward to sharing this with all of you. FREE BYRD

Thanks for all the cool questions lately about my training/diet/conditioning and why I slimmed down for my current role I’m filming now (Benny Safdie’s Lizard Music). I took almost a year to lose approximately 50lbs - from stepping on set to film, “The Smashing Machine” weighing 282lbs, to my current weight today - 235lbs. Last time I was this weight, was my freshman football season at University of Miami. I was a little “light in the ass”, for a defensively tackle, but still a monster 👹😉 At this current weight and body composition, I’ve never felt better - strength, endurance, cardiovascular, metabolic health, inflammation, joints, insulin sensitivity, stress hormones, immune function, incredible pumps etc. I wanted to take my time, drop the weight in a smart, wise and healthy way - nothing extreme. I also focus on partitioning my carbs strictly around my training and tapering off from there. What’s also made a HUGE impact in my progress was completely cutting out all refined sugars. For an athlete who was constantly battling a calorie surplus 😂🙋🏽‍♂️🤦🏽‍♂️ this move was transformative. Also keeping fat on the lower side as well. 50-60g daily. Appreciate all your great questions, hope this insight is helpful for your own journey. you vs. you

Post workout meal since I’m always on the go and don’t have time to sit down and eat. (approx 30-45min after training) - 75g protein powder (prototype I’m working on) - 1 cup blueberries - Ice - Stevia - 125g of carbs cooked jasmine rice Blend. Enjoy. Lots of great questions about my current training split, diet, cardio + conditioning. My current weight is 232-235lbs and holding conditioning very nicely. I took a full year to drop 50lbs for my current role I’m shooting now (Benny Safdie’s “Lizard Music”). Wanted to be strategic and wise about the weight cut and not implement anything extreme. My high carb days (approx 450grams carbs) fall on my 2 leg days + Sun and my low/medium carb days (250-300g) fill out the rest of the week. Feel phenomenal at this weight, strength, endurance, pumps with training are all fantastic- cardiovascular is excellent and holding conditioning nice and tight. Of course my muscle fullness fluctuates through the week with lower carb days, but nothing a few pre workout rice cakes, honey and pinch of salt can’t fix 😋 💪🏾  #prototype  #protein

Fam - wanted to give you a quick tour of the brand new IRON PARADISE ⚔️ I’ll give you guys another proper tour once it’s 💯 complete, but for now here’s the cliff notes version 😉💪🏾 Enjoy…. IRON PARADISE 10.0 3 years to build. Devil’s in the details. My sacred sanctuary ~ where progress, peace and “no mind” is chased daily. Some construction + architectural details for ya that you’ll appreciate ~ I wanted everything exposed so it had that industrial grit feel because it’s time to work 👍🏾 🏗️ Clear open structure for mana + energy to flow. Vaulted ceiling with giant fan and cupola windows and screens for air flow. No interior columns. Exposed metal roofing. Exposed structural steel beams. Exposed ducts & HVAC system. Exposed conduits and electrical outlets. All walls corrugated black steel. Custom steel doors and windows. Steel accents at all baseboard and door/window openings. “StarFire” mirrors 🔥🪞 heyyyyyyyy 🦵🏾😂 Stainless steel kitchen. Old school hot rocks sauna. Red light therapy. ** Thumpin’ sound system calibrated with four exposed ceiling speakers and four floor mounted big ass subs 😈 (music must come correct;) At the heart of the Iron Paradise is my daily reminder of the Japanese philosophy called Mushin - “mind, no mind” (flow state). In the center and the grounding of the entire gym is the Japanese Ensō ~ the beauty and power of life’s imperfections, and the truth that we never have to be perfect to be WHOLE — and the incomplete Ensō is the reminder that in life, there’s always room for growth and progress. And that’s the challenge I chase these days ~ progress and peace. Hope you enjoyed the tour, have a kick ass week and keep chasing your own progress and peace. And chase carbs too. Carbs are our friend 😜 Huge salute of respect and gratitude to our General Contractor and builder, MARK DREXLER & ASSOCIATES. We’ve worked for years now on my Iron Paradise sanctuary and our entire Johnson property. There’s no one better. Thank you Mark and your team for seeing our “vision” through in a very cool and special way. #IronParadise 10.0 #mysanctuary #mytherapist #sweatequity #grit

College is back, baby!🔥 Our PAPATUI trucks pulled up on campuses across the country and surprised my guys with big PAPA buckets for them to stock up all semester 👊🏾 Study hard ✔️  Train hard ✔️  Party hard ✔️  While you’re at it you may as well… Look good  Smell good Feel good  🚿🧼🧴 Good luck this year, boys and reminder these wise words from Uncle Rock — I got an atrocious .7 GPA 👀 my first semester at Miami - but then got my ass into gear and eventually became academic captain of the team. Not reinventing the wheel here, but started blending my rice with my protein powder for a fast digesting pre workout. Usually I do the old school Cream of Rice (orange box) which has always been the staple but this blended jasmine rice change up works great too. By the time I get to my first round of working sets I’m ready to go. Good to add to your rotation, give it a shot and lemme know. (my intra shake I sip on throughout my training is usually 50g dextrin carbs + 1/2 teaspoon Himalayan salt + EAAs + 275-300mgs caffeine + 10g creatine) See ya in the Iron Paradise 🫵🏾
